# Theme Token — Technical Reference

Theme Token publishes ShadCN-compatible themes as 1Sat Ordinals on BSV.
themetoken.dev provides the Studio, validation, previews, discovery, and a
ShadCN registry endpoint.

## When to use Theme Token

Use Theme Token for work that involves a Theme Token document, an on-chain
ShadCN theme, or a related design asset published through the Theme Token
protocol. Typical jobs include resolving a theme from its 1Sat origin,
validating theme JSON, producing a ShadCN registry response, installing a theme,
and publishing a theme with immutable asset references.

For component APIs and composition guidance, use the ShadCN documentation. For
raw transaction, ownership, or inscription data, use the 1Sat APIs.

- [Contact](https://themetoken.dev/contact)
- [Privacy](https://themetoken.dev/privacy)

Install a published theme:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json
```

`[origin]` is a 1Sat origin: a 64-character lowercase transaction ID, an
underscore, and the output index.

## Theme document

An `ord-fs/json` package stores the theme in `theme.json`. The registry endpoint
validates that file and serves the ShadCN registry item used by the CLI.

Required root fields:

- `$schema`: `https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json`
- `name`: a non-empty display name
- `styles.light` and `styles.dark`: complete style maps

`author`, `assets`, `css`, and `generation` are optional. Older documents may
contain `bundle` metadata; it is accepted but does not drive asset compilation.

Each style requires:

- `background`, `foreground`
- `card`, `card-foreground`
- `popover`, `popover-foreground`
- `primary`, `primary-foreground`
- `secondary`, `secondary-foreground`
- `muted`, `muted-foreground`
- `accent`, `accent-foreground`
- `destructive`, `destructive-foreground`
- `border`, `input`, `ring`
- `radius`

Additional string-valued CSS variables are accepted. Common options include
charts, sidebar colors, font families, spacing, letter spacing, and shadows.
The Studio writes complete OKLCH values such as `oklch(0.55 0.22 255)`.

Generation details may be recorded with `generation.prompt` and optional
`provider`, `model`, and `timestamp` fields.

## Related assets

The optional `assets` array links a theme to immutable fonts, patterns, and
wallpapers. Each relationship declares its role, kind, source, media type, and
SHA-256 integrity value. Sources can point to a sibling output in the same
transaction or an existing ordinal origin.

```json
{
  "role": "background.page",
  "kind": "pattern",
  "source": { "kind": "sibling", "vout": 0 },
  "mediaType": "image/svg+xml",
  "integrity": "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
  "delivery": "linked",
  "render": { "mode": "mask", "repeat": "repeat" }
}
```

Supported roles are `font.sans`, `font.serif`, `font.mono`, `font.heading`,
`background.page`, `background.card`, and `background.sidebar`. Supported kinds
are `font`, `pattern`, and `wallpaper`.

## MAP discovery

The package manifest carries the MAP record:

```json
{
  "app": "theme-token",
  "type": "registry:theme",
  "name": "Theme Name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Theme Name"
}
```

Current package mappings:

| Package | MAP fields |
|---|---|
| Theme | `type=registry:theme` |
| Font | `type=registry:asset`, `kind=font`, `mediaType=...` |
| Pattern | `type=registry:asset`, `kind=pattern`, `mediaType=image/svg+xml` |
| Wallpaper | `type=registry:asset`, `kind=wallpaper`, `mediaType=...` |
| Image | `type=registry:asset`, `kind=image`, `mediaType=...` |

MAP records include `app`, `type`, `name`, `version`, and `description`.
Asset records also include `kind` and `mediaType`. Author, license, prompt,
provider, and model are optional provenance fields.

## Registry response

`GET /r/themes/[origin].json` returns a ShadCN `registry:theme` item with the
theme's CSS variables, optional CSS rules, and verified asset behavior.
Vendored text assets appear in its `files` array as `registry:file` entries.
Verify an origin with:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json --dry-run
```

Readers accept the earlier MAP types `registry:style`, `theme-token:asset`,
`registry:file`, and `registry:font`; publishers use the mappings above.

## SDK

```ts
import {
  applyTheme,
  fetchThemeByOrigin,
  parseCss,
  toShadcnRegistry,
  validateThemeToken,
} from "@theme-token/sdk";

const published = await fetchThemeByOrigin("<txid>_0");
if (!published) throw new Error("Theme not found");
applyTheme(published.theme.styles.light);
```

- `validateThemeToken(data)` validates a theme document.
- `parseCss(css, name)` converts `:root` and `.dark` variables.
- `fetchThemeByOrigin(origin)` loads a published theme.
- `toShadcnRegistry(theme)` creates a ShadCN registry item.
- `applyTheme(styles)` applies one light or dark style map.

## Scope

Publishing, ownership, discovery, marketplace listings, and registry delivery
currently use BSV and 1Sat Ordinals.
